visualize_densepose_results: create a DensePoseResultsVisualizer to visualize dense pose chart results and bounding boxes on a BGR image
visualize_masked_colormap: build a DensePoseMaskedColormapResultsVisualizer to overlay masked colormap data extracted from IUV arrays onto images
visualize_contour_mpl: create a DensePoseResultsMplContourVisualizer to draw U and V contour lines on images using matplotlib
visualize_contour_custom: build a DensePoseResultsCustomContourVisualizer to draw marching squares contour lines on dense pose results without matplotlib
visualize_fine_segmentation: create a DensePoseResultsFineSegmentationVisualizer to visualize fine body part segmentation labels with a colormap overlay
